mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish: the temperature is 60 degrees at Harriet Park under clear skies with a moderate air quality index of 61. We have a Waxing Gibbous moon tonight and the International Space Station will be visible at 5:47 AM, rising over Cross Plains and heading toward the Madison area near Home Depot. The overnight low will reach 49 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona Plan Commission is meeting November 4th to review several proposals, including the Ardent Glen third addition, property splits on Jenna Drive, and a site plan for 1979 Milky Way. Additionally, residents are reminded that property tax bills will be mailed no later than December 15th.
There is plenty to do in our community today, including Yoga at Insight Wellness, the ART House 360 Thursday night series, and trivia at the Hop Haus Brewing Company.
On Thursday, October 15th, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I. Officers confirmed no injuries occurred to the students or public during the incident.
You can enjoy today's delicious flavor of the day, Dark Chocolate PB Crunch, at the Culver's of Verona, which remains open for you until 10 PM tonight.
